item.title: A bridge across Long Island Sound? Lawmakers are considering it
item.description: The array of bills vying for passage in the 2026 legislative session includes numerous long-shot proposals, though none quite as long — literally — as the push to eventually construct a 14-mile bridge across Long Island Sound.
